description: Searchable measures how brands appear in AI answers across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Connect it to see your visibility score and how it moves over time, your share of voice against named competitors, the sentiment of what models say about you, which websites models cite when answering questions in your category, and which of your pages AI crawlers actually fetch and cite. It also reads your connected Google Analytics 4 and Search Console data so AI-answer visibility can be compared against organic search and referral traffic, surfaces prioritized opportunities to improve how you show up, and can generate a shareable report of the findings.

defaultPrompt: How visible is my brand in AI answers compared to my competitors?
Which websites do AI models cite most when answering questions about my industry?
What are AI models saying about my brand — is the sentiment positive or negative?
